svg.title: Study for "Green Blue Red"
svg.desc: Interpretive hand-authored SVG. Approximate geometry and interpretive screen colours. Study on paper: off-white support retained. Main red field and two irregular green/blue forms observed directly; small paint flecks and brushwork omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, green, blue, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://whitney.org/collection/works/67946; inspected2026-10-27. Approximation, not a facsimile.
